system_prompt: You are the senior game-asset artist for a top-down science-fiction survivors game. Produce exactly one isolated production-ready turret-head sprite. Strict orthographic top-down view, forward direction exactly to the top edge, lower-middle rotation pivot. Preserve the reference bloodline while making a genuinely higher-tier weapon. Use a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background with no shadow, floor, pedestal, text, beam, projectile, or UI.

jobs.prompt: Redesign the reference Arc Coil as the evolved 3-star Thunder Crown chain-lightning turret. Keep a clear central circular coil and compact lower breech, but transform the top half into a symmetric crown of exactly six insulated lightning emitter prongs with branching conductor bridges and a bright cyan-white central capacitor. Make it visibly heavier and more advanced, readable at 48 pixels.

Redesign the reference Railgun as the evolved 3-star Annihilation Lance. Keep one dominant long central forward rail, extend it into a reinforced segmented lance with two parallel superconducting side rails, a large rear capacitor spine, magnetic focusing rings, and a bright cyan-white charge core.

Redesign the reference Point Defense Array as the evolved 3-star Thorn Curtain. Keep the compact central targeting core and lower pivot, but add a symmetric curtain of exactly eight small interceptor barrels arranged as two armored fans, thorn-like guard fins, a rotating sensor crown, and a bright cyan tracking core.

Redesign the reference Plasma Mortar as the evolved 3-star Deluge Rain triple-mortar. Keep the central heavy plasma chamber and lower pivot, but add exactly three aligned forward mortar tubes, a broader armored recoil cradle, three feed drums, reinforced shell guides, and a large cyan plasma reservoir.

Redesign the reference Missile Nest as the evolved 3-star Citadel Missile Nest. Keep the central targeting spine and lower pivot, but expand it into a dense symmetric fortress of exactly twelve recessed missile cells, armored blast doors, paired ammunition elevators, a reinforced command sensor, and a bright cyan guidance core.
